<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#E7ECF0"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="34" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="19" y="21" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">9:41</text>
  <line x1="323" y1="19" x2="327" y2="19" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="334" y2="17" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="15" x2="341" y2="15" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="13" x2="348" y2="13" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="361" cy="17" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="361" y1="12" x2="361" y2="10" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="371" y="11" width="17" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="373" y="13" width="12" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#141619"/>
  <rect x="388" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#141619"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="34" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="73" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#141619">Trends</text>
  <circle cx="359" cy="64" r="16" fill="#B9DCF7"/>
  <circle cx="359" cy="64" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="363.5" y1="68.5" x2="368" y2="73" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="356" y1="64" x2="362" y2="64" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="359" y1="61" x2="359" y2="67" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="1.4"/>

  <!-- Search -->
  <rect x="0" y="96" width="390" height="72" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="16" y="110" width="358" height="44" rx="22" fill="#E7ECF0"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="131" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="136" x2="50" y2="141" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="62" y="136" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Search Twitter</text>
  <circle cx="350" cy="132" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="128" x2="355" y2="128" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="132" x2="355" y2="132" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="136" x2="355" y2="136" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Location strip -->
  <rect x="0" y="168" width="390" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="195" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="195" r="3" fill="#4C9EEB"/>
  <text x="47" y="191" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Trends location</text>
  <text x="47" y="208" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">Worldwide</text>
  <polyline points="360,191 365,196 360,201" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>

  <!-- Empty state card shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="17" y="239" width="356" height="298" rx="14" fill="#BDC5CD" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="17" y="237" width="356" height="298" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Illustration -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="304" r="42" fill="#B9DCF7"/>
  <polygon points="166,329 181,310 191,320 204,301 224,329" fill="#4C9EEB" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="213" cy="294" r="7" fill="#FFA800"/>
  <line x1="162" y1="330" x2="227" y2="330" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="304" r="42" fill="none" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.5"/>

  <text x="195" y="378" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#141619">No trends available</text>
  <text x="195" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">We couldn't find trends for</text>
  <text x="195" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">your current location.</text>
  <text x="195" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Try changing your trends location</text>
  <text x="195" y="476" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">to see what's happening nearby.</text>

  <!-- Primary location button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="94" y="493" width="202" height="40" rx="20" fill="#4C9EEB"/>
    <text x="195" y="519" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Change location</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Helpful lower content -->
  <rect x="0" y="558" width="390" height="112" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="585" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#141619">Customize your trends</text>
  <text x="20" y="610" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Choose a location to get trends that matter</text>
  <text x="20" y="630" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">most to you.</text>
  <text x="20" y="654" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4C9EEB">Explore settings</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="670" x2="390" y2="670" stroke="#CED5DC" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Floating compose -->
  <circle cx="337" cy="708" r="29" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="337" cy="705" r="28" fill="#4C9EEB"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="713" x2="345" y2="696" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="714" x2="333" y2="713" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="697" x2="348" y2="701" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="744" x2="390" y2="744" stroke="#CED5DC" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,765 28,774 28,787 50,787 50,774" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="26,775 39,764 52,775" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="39" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#687684">Home</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Search active -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="117" cy="774" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="124" y1="781" x2="131" y2="788" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="117" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#4C9EEB">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Notifications -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="763" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="187" y="767" width="16" height="15" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="784" x2="207" y2="784" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="204" cy="766" r="4" fill="#CE395F"/>
    <text x="195" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#687684">Notifications</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Messages -->
  <g>
    <rect x="263" y="766" width="23" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="267,782 267,787 273,782" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="274" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#687684">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="350" cy="771" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="785" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="350" y="808" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#687684">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="830" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#060606"/>
</svg>
